p: mountains: He speaks of all the places where the Israelites accustomed to commit their idolaters, threatening them with destruction.
idols: In contempt of their power and force, which will neither be able to deliver you or themselves.
that ye may have some that: He shows that in all dangers God will preserve a few, which will be as the seed of his Church and call on his Name.
shall lothe themselves for the evils: They will be ashamed to see that their hope in idols was in vain, and so will repent.
Smite with thy hand: By these signs he would that the prophet would signify the great destruction to come.
ye know that I am the: That is, all nations when you will see my judgments.
than the wilderness toward Diblath: Which was in Syria and bordered on Israel, or from the wilderness which was south, to Diblath which was north: meaning the while country.
